public class DNA {
    public static void main(String args[]) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = sc.next();
        int count = 1;
        int i = 0;
        int toPrint = 0;
        if(i + 1 == str.length()){
            System.out.println(0);
            System.exit(0);
        }
        while (i + 1 < str.length()) {
            if(str.charAt(i) == str.charAt(i + 1)){
                count++;
                if(i+2>=str.length()){
                    if(count%2 == 0){
                        toPrint++;
                    }
                }
            } else{
                if(count%2 == 0){
                    toPrint++;
                    count = 1;
                } else{
                    count = 1;
                }
            }
            i++;
        }
        if(i - 1 >=0){
            if(i == str.length()){
                if(str.charAt(i) != str.charAt(i -1)){
                    toPrint++;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(toPrint);
    }
}
